// Fixture for T-0002 AC4: a module's api/ package must expose no infrastructure types, so it
// must not import infrastructure at all (invariant 20, ADR-0026 extraction-readiness).
package api

import (
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

// Reader leaks a pg type across the module boundary — exactly what AC4 forbids.
type Reader interface {
	Load(tx pgx.Tx, id string) error
}
